svg.text: Local-first model and verification engine · Git-backed intent · external agent coordination · M0–M4 + current M5
Roles may be held by the same person, but approval authority is separate.
Local processes + shared libraries; no central daemon or model database.
Code and .vcv/ travel together in the same PR; local cache and UI state are excluded.
GitHub / configured project CI / proposed agent orchestration
Base-owned workflow; candidate code runs only in the test job.
Intent and claims are distinct records in the same folder.
Issue events → developer · PR events → reviewer / PM
External integration — not built into VCV
Trust list · policy · approved model + code
Solid arrows: operations / control · dotted blue: reads / observations · dashed orange: proposed external automation · purple: persistent records · green: VCV components
Approved IR defines intent. Git records implementation. Evidence relates the two. Local gate is advisory; required CI check enforces policy when configured.
VCV checks declared structure, lineage, bindings and evidence; agents reason about semantic correctness. Reconciliation never silently rewrites intent.
